Array.shuffle = function <T>(arr: T[], Irng: MathRandomType = Math.random) {
    let randomIndex;
    let tempValue;
    let index;
    for (index = arr.length - 1; index > 0; --index) {
        randomIndex = randomRangeAsInt(0, index, rng);
        tempValue = arr[index];
        arr[index] = arr[randomIndex];
        arr[randomIndex] = tempValue;
    }
    return arr;
};

Array.callAround = function <U>(length: number, callfn: (i: number, length: number) => void, mapfn: (i: number, length: number) => U): U[] {
